verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requires delivery of the designed document as a print-ready PDF, establishing the output format and print-readiness acceptance condition.
The client adds concrete export and delivery constraints: one cleanly exported PDF sufficiently compact for email submission; no prior attributes become obsolete.
First concrete verification of export and email-size suitability: the PDF was exported with digital-distribution settings and measured well below 25 MB.
Distinct end-to-end verification: the client successfully emailed the final PDF and Civic Canopy confirmed receipt.
